text:
sam: Ran end-to-end benchmarks across GPUs/regions for Llama2-13B, Mistral-7B-v1, and Qwen-7B. Focus: long context (32k), GQA/rope behavior, and kernel compat. Uploading summary charts in the thread. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

sam: TL;DR — H100 gives best latency for 32k on Llama/Mistral, Qwen shows a rope scaling mismatch on H100 that inflates latency at ~>8k context. A100 decent throughput for batchy inference but tails worse. L4 good for low-cost short-context.

ara: can you paste the raw numbers? especially p50/p95 and tokens/sec per GPU/region.

sam: pasted below (quick ascii table from perf script):

```
model     | gpu  | region     | ctx | p50(ms) | p95(ms) | tok/s
Llama-13B | H100 | us-east-1  | 32k | 210     | 420     | 480
Mistral7B | H100 | us-east-1  | 32k | 180     | 360     | 620
Qwen-7B   | H100 | us-east-1  | 32k | 300     | 760     | 260  <- rope mismatch
Llama-13B | A100 | eu-west-1  | 32k | 260     | 540     | 380
Mistral7B | A100 | eu-west-1  | 32k | 220     | 460     | 480
Qwen-7B   | A100 | eu-west-1  | 32k | 280     | 600     | 300
Llama-13B | L4   | us-west-2  | 8k  | 95      | 210     | 820
Mistral7B | L4   | us-west-2  | 8k  | 85      | 180     | 920
Qwen-7B   | L4   | us-west-2  | 8k  | 120     | 320     | 440
```

sam: Notes: numbers are single-worker microbench (no autoscaling). p95 includes kernel fallback for Qwen on H100 in us-east-1, which spikes the tail.

jin: rope scaling mismatch — do you see numerically that GQA attention indices blow up? any sign of rotary vs rope paramization diverging?

sam: yes — Qwen's rope implementation needs the newer GQA-offset handling. On H100 we rely on flash attention kernel that expects certain rotary scaling; when kernel falls back to reference we get big overhead. The fallback path is the culprit for the p95 spikes.

perf-bot: Perf summary generated: https://perf.internal/reports/1763600000 — includes flamegraphs and kernel selection heatmaps (flash_attn vs fallback).

rachel: For kernel choices: flash_attn fused path wins for Mistral/Llama (less mem-copy). For Qwen, we need either a patched flash kernel or use xformers with modified rotary scaling. Recommendation: for production in us-east-1 H100, pin Qwen to the "qwen-rope-fix" variant until we get kernel update.

mike: On quantization — how did 4-bit GPTQ affect quality for these models at long context? Any regression vs int8? We're sizing dedicated pools and want to know tradeoffs.

sam: Quick notes from eval set (500 prompts, long-context stress):
- Llama+4bit: negligible Rouge/EM drop (~0.5-1%) vs int8 baseline.
- Mistral+4bit: slightly higher hallucination on rare tokens (~1.5% precision drop).
- Qwen+4bit: larger regressions around context-windowed QA if rope/scaling mismatched (~3% drop).

sam: So recommendation: use GPTQ-4 for Llama/Mistral in Dedicated for cost savings, but hold off for Qwen until rope/quantization integration tested.

ara: For capacity sizing — any data on tokens/sec at steady-state for mixed workloads (chat + embeddings)?

sam: example steady-state mix (70% chat 30% embeddings) tokens/sec per H100 worker: ~12k toks/sec for Mistral cluster configs, ~8k for Llama-13B. Int8 increases throughput ~1.4x; 4-bit GPTQ around ~1.8x but requires eval. 

jin: Important: region differences — eu-west-1 A100 hosts have older NCCL versions; we saw a kernel selection difference causing more fallbacks. Ops should standardize driver/kernel stack across regions.

rachel: I'll open an ops ticket to sync kernels and drivers across eu-west-1/us-east-1. We should also add a canary that validates kernel selection for each model after infra patching.

mike: Any temporary mitigations? We need SLAs.

sam: Strategies:
- Pin Qwen to the patched model variant in routing rules (fast to deploy).
- For queries above 8k ctx, route Qwen->Mistral fallback with automatic fallback policy in the runtime for critical routes.
- Add a profiling rule to reject requests that trigger fallback more than N times in 1m and route to lower-context variant.

ara: can you share the bench command so se/team can reproduce?

sam: bench command we used:
```
python tools/bench.py \
  --model {model} \
  --device {cuda_device} \
  --context 32768 \
  --batch 1 \
  --profile --emit-json /tmp/bench_{model}_{device}.json
```

sam: also attached the perf_bot link with charts + kernel heatmaps. Plan: open PR for Qwen rope fix, patch runtime to avoid fallback on H100, and add canary tests in eu-west-1.

jin: I'll take the Qwen PR and test kernel patch locally on an H100 dev node.

rachel: Ops ticket created: OPS-2184 — sync NCCL/driver + add kernel-canary job.

mike: thanks team. I'll hold Dedicated capacity purchases for Qwen-heavy customers until we have the patch or pinned routing. :thumbsup:

sam: cool — will post follow-ups when PR/Ticket land.
